concerns.text: Spec FR‑002 mandates computing clustering descriptors *within the grain‑boundary interface region of the GB supercell* (post‑impurity insertion). Task T005 (and the plan) instead compute the three descriptors on the bulk configuration *before* impurity insertion, thereby weakening the functional requirement.

FR‑001 requires downloading bulk configuration files from **both** Materials Project and OQMD. The implementation plan explicitly omits Materials Project data ("Materials Project data are omitted due to lack of an unauthenticated open source on the free runner"). This violates Constitution Principle VI, which mandates sourcing from both repositories, and constitutes an unauthorized waiver.

FR‑011 demands validation of EAM‑derived segregation‑energy labels against a DFT benchmark set (≥30 samples, MAE ≤ 0.1 eV). Both the plan and tasks treat this requirement as waived ("FR‑011 waiver documented"), recording `[DATA_UNAVAILABLE]` instead of performing the validation. Waiving a mandatory functional requirement is not permitted by the constitution and leaves Success Criterion SC‑006 unaddressed.
